# Consciously accepted public API breaks, compared with the latest release tag.
#
# The "API Breakage" workflow runs `swift package diagnose-api-breaking-changes`
# against the newest semver tag and fails on every reported break that is not
# listed here. Add one exact message per line, without the emoji, for example:
#
# API breakage: func foo() has been removed
#
# Every entry needs a CHANGELOG entry explaining why the break is accepted.
# Entries are deleted when the release that contains the break is tagged,
# because the comparison baseline moves to that tag.
